title: Presque Isle Passage RV Park & Campground

services.name: Yurt Rentals
services.desc: Presque Isle Passage offers a full range of rental accommodations, from RV rentals to cabins to fully furnished conventional lodging. Whatever your needs, budget, and size of family (including pets!) or group, we have the option that is right for you. That’s right, we are pet-friendly and all of our rentals are also pet-friendly. The complete list of amenities for each unit are listed below, along with interior and exterior photos. Please note that guests must provide their own linens, towels, and bedding for all rental units. Listed rates include 2 adults except where noted. These rates do not include any applicable taxes or online booking fees. Please select a category from the tabs above
